== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] [[Era]] refers to an ancient period of history characterized by the creation of advanced [[Aethertech]]. Most of this technology was developed by humans, who are recognized as the species with a unique talent for such craftsmanship. This era saw the beginning of galactic expansion and featured highly sophisticated medical care, superior alloys, and advanced manufacturing processes that have since been lost to time. A defining feature of this period is the existence of seven [[Zenith Devices]], which are powerful, sentient artifacts. While many people consider these devices to be mere myths, they possess immense capabilities and operate according to specific rules. These artifacts are known for their significant egos and competitive nature; in fact, their initial awakening as rivals is believed to have brought the [[Zenith]] [[Era]] to a close. Despite this rivalry, their intended purpose was to foster the growth of galactic civilization. Notable examples of these devices include [[The Last Horizon]], a legendary starship that serves as an exemplar of craft, the [[Zenith Colony]], and the [[Zenith Processor]]. Historically, it is rare for more than two of these devices to be active simultaneously.}}
